The Nursing Home dashboard counts every resident (22, should be the 19 In Today); a resident taken off In Today is still on it

Note: Re-test 2026-10-16 on 25acd727 (640bc7c4): the dashboard opens on Today's Visits and counts only In Today residents; TC-20/S04a, S07, S02, S23 and TC-09/S09 pass locally. Also fixed on dev (2026-10-16 19:18–19:45 JST: TC-20/S04a, S04b, S06, S07, S23, TC-09/S09; unit U69 passes).

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S07 Nursing Home: un-mark and re-mark In Today, and the dashboard follows each time

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Nursing Home counts are based on the residents marked 'In Today'. Marking a resident adds them to the counts. Un-marking removes them from today's counts without deleting them from All Residents (UAT TC-09; TFA-92598 AC 4; TFA-92587 AC 6; TFA-92587 AC 2)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Standard fixture. The resident is In Today and pending

When Open the Nursing Home dashboard. Go to All Residents and un-mark the resident ('In Today' → '+ Today'). Open the dashboard. Go back, re-mark the resident, and open the dashboard again

Then The resident is on the dashboard at first (Total 1 / Pending 1). After the un-mark it is still on All Residents with '+ Today' (not deleted) and is off the dashboard's today counts (Total 0). After the re-mark it is back (Total 1 / Pending 1)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92587 AC 1, AC 2 and AC 6, TFA-92598 AC 4, UAT TC-09. Checked today: checkpoints 1 and 4 mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard' and the resident. Checkpoint 2 (All Residents after the un-mark) mustContain the resident and '+ Today', which is the resident's own toggle in the AC 1 wording. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the bug was fixed on 25acd727 and this re-test passes, so its status is kept (the rows below are about the older build).

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-92598 ready for qa

After the physician takes a resident off In Today, that resident still shows on the Nursing Home dashboard and is still counted.

Evidence: allure-results/ceae9c8d…: rest tier. ledger #69 (U69, checked): after the only resident is un-marked, the NH dashboard still lists them (Total 1, not 0). Same root as U57. Dev report §4. Un-mark and re-mark on All Residents work.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-20/S04a; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.
